Carry more, unlock Big Pack

Big Walk Backpack Location

Backpacks add a full extra item slot in Big Walk, and equipping one for the first time unlocks the Big Pack achievement.

Where to Find One

Gamerant notes that a backpack lets players carry more than one item, and wearing one unlocks the Big Pack achievement. Insider Gaming explains the first opportunity: reach the Red Tower, take the binoculars from the top, and look down the hill toward the blue building. One of the backpack locations is near that blue building.

How Big Pack Unlocks

  1. Reach the Red Tower area. The first backpack opportunity comes after the red drawbridge section.
  2. Find a backpack. Look for the blue building visible from the Red Tower's top with the binoculars.
  3. Equip it. The backpack adds an extra item slot with no size or shape restriction, according to guide coverage.
  4. Big Pack unlocks automatically the first time you wear one; no extra objective is required.

Why it matters: a backpack removes the one-item limit for tools such as a map, compass, or lantern, which helps with puzzle-heavy areas and the Big View/Big Climb achievements.
